messages:
Eli: Sharing new dashboard layout (compact) — main concerns: filter chips keyboard order, metric label contrast, and whether screen readers understand the grid. Quick pass please. https://mock.redwood/compact-v2.png

Nora: Quick run: metric label contrast (#757575 on #FFFFFF) -> ~4.1:1. Recommend bumping token. Filter chips are visually re-ordered with CSS \"order\" which breaks tab order.

Sam: Agree on both. For screen readers if it's a semantic grid of metrics use role=grid with gridcell and row headers. If it's a collection of independent metrics use role=region + aria-labelledby per card.

A11yBot: automated-scan: issues=4; critical=color-contrast(1), focus(1), order(1), aria(1). Report: https://a11y.redwood/1767502222.json

Eli: I prefer cards (flexible). Nora, can you propose new hex for secondary text? Also want a simple CSS focus rule that doesn't rely on box-shadow.

Nora: Use `--text-secondary: #2E2E2E` to reach >=4.5:1. Focus: `:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus-accent); outline-offset: 2px; }`. Add `.sr-skip` link and ensure `<main id\="content\" role\="main\">` receives focus on route change.

Sam: For virtualized list we should emit `aria-posinset`/`aria-setsize` and `aria-roledescription\=\"metric card\"`. Avoid double announcements by preferring moving focus to main instead of aria-live.

QA: I'll add keyboard smoke tests: tab through header -> skip link -> filters -> first card. Also add contrast check in CI. Need final hex and token names to add snapshots.

Eli: Owners: Nora implement tokens & focus styles; Sam update markup for cards and virtual list; QA add tests. Target PR by 1768100000 (end of sprint).

A11yBot: note: deploy-time check will fail if body text contrast <4.5:1.

Nora: Dropping tokens: `--text-secondary: #2E2E2E`, `--focus-accent: #FFB238`. I'll open a small PR with screenshots.
